title: Statement of 3 June 1947 (the "3 June Plan")
source: His Majesty's Government; broadcast from New Delhi by the Viceroy, Lord Mountbatten
description: The statement setting out the method by which British India would be partitioned and power transferred, including the provision for boundary commissions in the Punjab and Bengal.

title: Report of the Punjab Boundary Commission (the Radcliffe Award)
source: Punjab Boundary Commission, chaired by Sir Cyril Radcliffe
description: The award fixing the boundary between East and West Punjab, published on 17 August 1947, two days after independence. A companion award partitioned Bengal.
